svg.title: The environment beneath the work
svg.desc: Muninn flies in to deliver a learned check to the testing layer; five safeguards support the work throughout the run.
svg.text: Start with the strongest suitable home. Guide judgment where enforcement stops.

g.text: Set limits on actions and access.
Check the work and the complete operation.
Passing checks prove only what they test.
Put relevant rules beside the affected work.
The agent must still follow them.
Help the agent decide how to do the work.
State expectations that need human judgment.
Depend on being read and followed.

svg.text: These safeguards support the whole run; they are not steps in a sequence.
